definitions.explanation: A period during which farmland is left unplanted, either to rest the soil or because it is not the growing season.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{休耕期|きゅうこうき}だ。
{休耕期|きゅうこうき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{土|つち}→土：02229_tsuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{休|やす}ませる→休む：00606_yasumu⟧。
examples.english: Rest the soil during the fallow period.

examples.japanese: {休耕期|きゅうこうき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{農機具|のうきぐ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手入|てい}れ→手入れ：07178_teire⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: During the fallow period, we maintain the farm equipment.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{休耕|きゅうこう}→休耕：19194_kyuukou⟧ (leaving land fallow) + {期|き} (period). Refers to when fields are deliberately left uncultivated.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {休耕期|きゅうこうき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to enter the fallow period
- {休耕期|きゅうこうき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{畑|はたけ}→畑：00842_hatake⟧: a fallow field

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{農閑期|のうかんき}→農閑期：25613_noukanki⟧: agricultural off-season — the slack season for farm work in general
- ⟦{休耕田|きゅうこうでん}→休耕田：25754_kyuukouden⟧: fallow rice paddy — a field left uncultivated
